about.heading: About
about.body: SAMUDRA was established in Jakarta in 1984 with the aim of providing superior exhibition construction services to clients based in Indonesia. The company's scope of business was steadily expanded to provide full exhibition management services to clients participating in domestic and overseas expositions, trade fairs and exhibitions, conventions and seminars.

items.title: Exhibition Construction
items.description: From concept to execution, we create impactful exhibition experiences with our comprehensive design and construction services.

items.title: Special Projects
items.description: Certified event management experts delivering seamless execution for seminars, conventions, exhibitions, and specialty events.

items.title: Interior Design & Build
items.description: Creative interior design and build solutions for residential, showroom, and office spaces with professional quality.
